The sample audit has been rerun with **iPhone Duo first** and real device frames for all **18 orientations across five profiles**.

Framed and clean PNGs are captured in the same audit callback, before another game update. The hosted report shows the device surrounds and camera cutouts, with links to full-resolution framed PNGs, clean-coordinate evidence and the original audit JSON.

[Open the refreshed audit](https://dghn.github.io/editorcraft-device-simulator-tools/puzzle-audit/)

## Results

- Unity 6000.6.5f1, captured 26 October 2026 at 12:13 UTC.
- 329 UI objects checked per snapshot; zero skipped objects.
- Four geometry warnings: the JELLY title RectTransform exceeds safe bounds in Duo inner/outer landscape views. These warnings remain visible; geometry checks do not establish readability.
- Published HTML, JSON and all 18 framed images verified against local file hashes.
- Static package checks and all seven installer tests passed.

This is a documentation/media release; it does not change runtime or Editor tooling behavior. Earlier Unity versions remain unverified, not excluded by a package-declared minimum. No fresh earlier-Editor or clean-install verification is claimed.
